IP65 # Radar Fall Detection Sensor Protecting Mobility-Challenged Individuals Alone VS373 Radar ![vs373 fall detector 1 small](https://www.milesight.com/static/pc/en/product/product/lorawan-sensor/vs373/vs373-fall-detector-1-small.png?t=1785483782958) ![vs373 fall detector 3 small](https://www.milesight.com/static/pc/en/product/product/lorawan-sensor/vs373/vs373-fall-detector-3-small.png?t=1785483782958) ![vs373 fall detector 5 small](https://www.milesight.com/static/pc/en/product/product/lorawan-sensor/vs373/vs373-fall-detector-5-small.png?t=1785483782958) - High Fall Detection Accuracy of Up to 99% - 24/7 Monitoring Even in Dark and Humid Environments - 100% Privacy Protection - Contactless Fall Detection - IP65 Waterproof and Dustproof - Support DO Interface - Detect Breath, Occupancy, Bed Presence, Movement - Instant Alerts For Immediate Intervention - Software Compatibility To Unlock Data Potential - FEATURES - MODELS - DOWNLOAD - [Home](https://www.milesight.com/) - [IoT LoRaWAN® Series](https://www.milesight.com/iot/#lorawan-sensor) - vs373 ## Enhanced Safety: Reliable Fall Detection Sensor for the Elderly The VS373 Fall Detection Sensor ensures stable and contactless monitoring, instantly detecting falls and other abnormal movements when the individual is alone. Powered by advanced fall detection technology, it contributes to achieving smart healthcare and developing comprehensive elderly care solutions. Notice: The side cable of the VS373 is non-removable. The following illustration shows the appearance after installation, with the side cable hidden. ![maxresdefault](https://i.ytimg.com/vi/abHiZWWPyQM/maxresdefault.jpg) ![maxresdefault](https://i.ytimg.com/vi/FgcjqMZwyu8/maxresdefault.jpg) IntroductionInstallation Guide ## Advanced Radar & AI for High-Accuracy Fall Detection Looking for a smart device to ensure safety in emergencies? Meet Milesight VS373, an intelligent fall detection solution for medical and elderly care. Powered by advanced 4D 60-GHz mmWave radar and AI, it delivers superior precision and reliability even through obstacles. With non-contact and high-privacy monitoring, VS373 achieves up to 99% fall detection accuracy. ## Ideal for Elderly Care and Medical Facilities VS373 is compatible with many smart platforms. Ideal for nursing home rooms, hospital wards, smart public restrooms, and accessible restrooms, the VS373 enhances traditional alarm systems, providing exceptional safety and peace of mind, and protecting mobility-challenged individuals when alone. ## Advanced Fall Detection and Alert ### Confirmation Phase: ### If a fall is detected, a red light will flash slowly. ### First Alert: ### If the fall is confirmed, the red light will flash quickly, and a buzzer will sound. After the user-configured Fall Delay Reporting Time, the incident will be reported. ### Emergency Alert: ### Once the alert is sent, the on-site alert will continue for a short period before stopping. [Notice: Milesight is not liable for any issues caused by environmental factors affecting performance.](https://resource.milesight.com/milesight/iot/document/vs373-disclaimer-and-important-information-en.pdf) ## Key Features of Fall Detection Sensor ### 4D 60-GHz mmWave Radar with MIMO Array Penetrating light and water mist obstacles for reliable and precise detection ### 99% Accurate Fall Detection with AI Algorithms Providing accurate and reliable timely alerts ### True 24/7 Continuous Monitoring Operating day and night without the need for visible light ### Supporting Multiple Detection Functions Supporting bed presence detection, room occupancy detection and motionless&over stay detection ### IP65 Waterproof and Dust-proof Ensures durability and reliable operation in various environments ### Absolute Privacy Protection No image capture, ensuring complete privacy for users ### Comprehensive Alarm System Buzzer, LED, and back-end reporting for immediate alerts ### Milesight Ecosystem Compatibility Supporting D2D protocol for low latency control and management via Milesight Development Platform ## More Than Just Fall Detection: Smarter Healthcare Monitoring Bed Presence Detection Monitor unexpected bed exits, including multi-bed scenarios, to reduce the risk of falls and to ensure timely emergency response. If patients leave the bed outside of scheduled times, caregivers are notified immediately for swift action. It also supports single-bed abnormal breathing rate detection for enhanced patient safety. Room Occupancy Detection Monitor space occupancy and trigger corresponding services. For example, when an accessible restroom is in use, other IoT devices within the space will activate. Report abnormal occupancy durations immediately via VS373. Motionless&Over Stay Detection Monitor if individuals with mobility issues remain in the same position for an extended period. For instance, send reminders to caregivers when the elderly are inactive for too long. This helps promote health and quickly identify any unexpected issues. ![vs373 patient hospital ward](https://www.milesight.com/static/pc/en/product/product/lorawan-sensor/vs373/vs373-patient-hospital-ward.jpg?t=1785483782958) ![vs373 disabled restroom](https://www.milesight.com/static/pc/en/product/product/lorawan-sensor/vs373/vs373-disabled-restroom.jpg?t=1785483782958) ![vs373 elder nursing home](https://www.milesight.com/static/pc/en/product/product/lorawan-sensor/vs373/vs373-elder-nursing-home.jpg?t=1785483782958) ## Perfect Fit for Various Indoor Settings VS373 is designed to enhance safety and provide timely assistance in diverse indoor environments. Whether for the elderly or individuals with disabilities, VS373 ensures accurate activity monitoring and fall alerts, greatly enhancing safety when they are alone indoors. It also supports customizable detection-free zones for areas with obvious interference or not intended for detection, along with adjustable sensitivity modes to better adapt to different environments. Nursing Home Rooms Continuous monitoring and timely alerts for quick response to falls and unusual movements, ensuring the safety of elderly residents. Hospital Wards Enhancing patient safety with real-time alerts, allowing medical staff to respond promptly to unusual situations. Smart Public Restrooms Detecting falls and unusual activity, providing immediate alerts for prompt assistance and ensuring user safety. Accessible Restrooms Monitoring restrooms designed for individuals with disabilities, ensuring quick response to falls and enhancing user safety. [Notice: This product is an auxiliary tool and cannot replace human supervision.](https://resource.milesight.com/milesight/iot/document/vs373-disclaimer-and-important-information-en.pdf) ## Enhance Quality of Life with Milesight D2D Using Milesight's D2D protocol, you can build a safer and more comfortable environment for mobility-challenged individuals and the elderly living alone. Devices interconnect directly for efficient and convenient control. With the expanded D2D functions, multiple alarm conditions can trigger device linkage, and all alarms support DO output, giving you full flexibility to choose which alarms to be included. ![vs373 d2d room healthcare](https://www.milesight.com/static/pc/en/product/product/lorawan-sensor/vs373/vs373-d2d-room-healthcare.jpg?t=1785483782958)[Read Blog >](https://www.milesight.com/company/blog/milesight-vs373-radar-fall-detection-sensor) Alarm Integration: Timely Human Intervention Instant alerts ensure prompt intervention, minimizing risks and enhancing safety for those in need. With the D2D protocol, devices can respond quickly, distinguishing it from traditional manual control. Lighting Integration: Smart Occupancy Sensing Lights automatically adjust based on occupancy, providing convenience and enhancing comfort. For example, lights turn off when no one is present, creating an intelligent and comfortable environment. HVAC Integration: Automated Comfort Control Through smart temperature and ventilation adjustments, it offers convenient environmental control and automatically adjusts temperature, achieving optimal comfort. ## Versatile Installation Installation Tips: Please pick the best method for your space. You can either ceiling mount with drilled holes and expansion bolts, or cutout mount with a larger hole and spring clips. Make sure to install it parallel to the ceiling and floor, and keep it at least 1 meter from the wall. ![vs373 installation ceiling mount](https://www.milesight.com/static/pc/en/product/product/lorawan-sensor/vs373/vs373-installation-ceiling-mount.png?t=1785483782958) Ceiling Mounting ![vs373 installation cutout mount](https://www.milesight.com/static/pc/en/product/product/lorawan-sensor/vs373/vs373-installation-cutout-mount.png?t=1785483782958) Cutout Mount ## Device Management & Application Development Milesight Development Platform Milesight Development Platform simplifies IoT deployments and management with plug-and-play device configurations, batch operations for multi-device handling, and API & webhooks for custom integration and application development. ![milesight development platform](https://www.milesight.com/static/pc/en/product/product/lorawan-sensor/vs125/milesight-development-platform.png?t=1785483782958) Milesight DeviceHub Mileisight DeviceHub is a all-in-one platform that allows you to manage your devices and make customized settings remotely, while ensuring highest levels of privacy and security. ![people counting data display](https://www.milesight.com/static/pc/en/product/product/lorawan-sensor/vs125/people-counting-data-display.png?t=1785483782958) ## People Sensing , Value Viewing Turn Invisible Scenes Into Visible Data, Gain More Insights And See The Future. When selecting a fall detection solution, consider the senior's mobility, daily habits, and environment. Unlike wearable devices, non-contact sensors—such as those installed in rooms or near beds—offer continuous monitoring without requiring the user to wear or charge anything. - Non-Wearable Convenience: Ideal for individuals who may forget or prefer not to wear a device. Sensors like ours detect falls automatically without user interaction. - Living Environment: Fixed-position sensors work well in bedrooms, bathrooms, or care facilities where most accidents tend to occur. - Accuracy & Speed: Choose a solution that offers real-time alerts and reliable fall detection, even when the user is alone. - Integration & Alerts: Look for systems that connect with caregiver platforms or emergency services to ensure faster response time. ### Is it easy to deploy and integrate Milesight's fall detection products into existing systems? Yes, Milesight's fall detection products are easy to deploy and integrate into existing systems. The sensors can be quickly installed without invasive setup. Utilizing Milesight gateways, support flexible data forwarding options such as MQTT broker, HTTP URL, and BACnet/IP protocols, makes it simple to connect with third-party platforms like nurse call systems, BMS, or cloud-based healthcare applications. This gateway-based architecture allows seamless integration while ensuring compatibility with a wide range of healthcare and building management environments. Configuration is straightforward enabling fast rollout across multiple spaces. ### What other products are included in Milesight's healthcare solution? Besides people sensing, fall, and occupancy detection, Milesight's healthcare solution also includes a full set of products to support smart and responsive care environments. These include temperature and humidity monitoring, indoor air quality sensors (such as CO₂ and TVOC sensors), and high-performance LoRaWAN® gateways for reliable connectivity. Together with the VS373, these devices form a complete deployment plan suitable for various healthcare spaces—including patient rooms, rest areas, corridors, and accessible restrooms—enabling efficient monitoring, real-time alerts, and improved care delivery. Here are some successful deployments that demonstrate how Milesight's healthcare solution has been implemented in real-world scenarios: For example, [Milesight's hospital temperature monitoring solution](https://www.milesight.com/company/success-stories/hospital-temperature-monitoring-solution) a local hospital in Singapore ensures patient safety and compliance and protect medical supplies by providing with Milesight's real-time temperature monitoring in key medical areas. Our [Milesight's smart healthcare solution](https://www.milesight.com/company/success-stories/smart-healthcare-solution-for-spain-health-centers) also helps in Spainish Health Centers improve energy efficiency and enhances well-being for patients and staffcare with real-time monitoring of temperature, humidity, and air quality, optimizing conditions and improving efficiency. ## Specifications - VS3731 | Fall Detection2 | | --- | | Technology | Millimeter Wave Radar | | Installation Height | 2.3m～3m | | Advanced Feature | Milesight D2D Controller & Agent, Dwell Detection, Lying Alarm, Multi-bed Presence Detection, Human In-Place Detection, Breathing Detection, Data Storage (1, 000 entries), Data Transmission, Data Retrievability | | Radar | | Transceiver | 24 Transmitters & 22 Receivers | | Frequency | 60GHz | | Tx Power | Max. 20 dBm | | FoV | 70 ° Horizontal, 140 ° Vertical | | Detection Range | 2m\*2m～4m\*5m (Within the installation height) | | Wireless Transmission | | LoRa | | Protocol | LoRaWAN®, Milesight D2D | | Antenna | Internal Antenna | | Frequency | CN470/IN865/EU868/RU864/US915/AU915/KR920/AS923-1&2&3&4 | | Tx Power | 16 dBm (868 MHz)/22 dBm (915MHz)/19 dBm (470MHz) | | Sensitivity | -137dBm @300bps | | Mode | OTAA/ABP Class C | | Wi-Fi | | Antenna | Internal Antenna | | Standard | IEEE 802.11b/g/n, 2.4 GHz | | Tx Power | 802.11b: 16 dBm +/-1.5 dBm (11 Mbps)
